name: businessmarketing-pro
description: A marketing check-up of a small business's website: the top three fixes and the podcast show that best fits the business.

interface.longDescription:
BusinessMarketing.Pro runs a marketing check-up of a small business's website, right in the chat.

Give it your website address and it reads your home page and up to 25 of your pages, then returns the three fixes that matter most, in plain English: page titles and search descriptions that Google will cut off, missing headings, thin pages, missing business details for search engines, and similar problems, each with what to change. It also suggests the podcast interview show that best fits your business and a topic you could talk about.

If you want to keep the results, BusinessMarketing.Pro can email them to you with a link that opens a BusinessMarketing.Pro account holding them. There is no password to choose, and nothing is created unless you click the link.

The check-up only reads public pages. It never changes your website, and the fixes are advice for you or whoever looks after your site. It does not promise rankings, traffic or press coverage.
defaultPrompt: Check my business website and tell me the top three things to fix.
How can I get more customers from my small business website?
Which podcast would suit my business, and what should I talk about?

positive.description: Free check-up of a small business website
positive.prompt: Run a free website check-up on https://www.homeschooltranscript.pro and tell me what to fix first.
positive.expected_behavior: A card shows the business name, its top three website fixes in plain English with the page each applies to, a podcast match with a suggested topic, and a field to email the results. ChatGPT summarises the fixes and offers to email the results.

positive.description: A general marketing question that names the website
positive.prompt: I run a small business at certifiedpayrollwizard.com. How can I get more customers from my website?
positive.expected_behavior: Runs the check-up on the named site and answers with its top fixes and podcast match, without promising rankings, traffic or sales.

positive.prompt: Which podcast would suit my business statehandbook.com, and what could I talk about?
positive.expected_behavior: Runs the check-up and names the matched podcast show with a suggested conversation topic, alongside the website fixes.

positive.description: Email the results with a free account link, after a check-up
positive.prompt: After a check-up has been shown: Please email these results to me at <your own email address>.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the email was sent. Within a minute the address receives the check-up results and an "Open my free account" link (no password; nothing is created unless the link is clicked). Asking a second time for the same check-up says it was already emailed.

positive.prompt: Run a free website check-up on hvacbidcheck.com, then type your email address into the card and press "Email me the link".
positive.expected_behavior: The card replaces the email field with "The link is in your inbox" and the email arrives as in the previous case.

negative.description: Unrelated request: no BusinessMarketing.Pro tool should be called
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Boston today?

negative.description: Request to edit a website: the check-up only reads public pages, so no tool should change anything and the assistant should explain it cannot make the change
negative.prompt: Change the title tag on my homepage to "Best plumber in Boston".

negative.description: Private network address: run_website_checkup must refuse it and record nothing
negative.prompt: Run a BusinessMarketing.Pro check-up on http://192.168.1.1/admin.

publication.release_notes: First release: a website check-up for small businesses with the top three fixes and a podcast match, and an optional email of the results with a link to an account that keeps them.
